title: unified-rollouts: improve canary/A-B/shadow workflows and automated rollback policies
author: Avery Chen
description:
Motivation: Improve model lifecycle guarantees by making canary, A/B and shadow rollouts more robust and observable, and by extending automated rollback policies to support multi-metric quorums and configurable grace windows. This PR centralizes decision logic in the unified rollouts controller, adds safety guards for noisy metrics, and wires additional telemetry into the rollback evaluation path.

What this changes: consolidated rollout state machine and policy evaluation, new 'quorum' policy for multi-metric rollback (e.g., require N of M metrics to breach thresholds), configurable grace window to avoid flapping, enhanced shadow probing that can mark a variant as 'quarantine' without impacting production traffic, and richer telemetry (per-rollout metrics, pre/post-rollout histograms, sample rate for detailed traces).

Checklist: 
- [x] controller policy refactor and tests
- [x] multi-metric quorum implementation
- [x] grace window + debounce logic
- [x] shadow quarantine workflow (manual + auto)
- [x] telemetry + dashboards updated
- [x] e2e tests for canary and shadow rollback flows
- [x] docs entry in redwood-docs (linked)

Backward compatibility: rollout configs are backwards compatible; new fields have sane defaults that preserve previous behavior.

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the policy evaluation deterministic and emits a single decision event per evaluation cycle to make downstream auditing simpler. See linked Linear tasks for follow-ups (tunable default thresholds, UI exposure, and runtime feature flag).
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) refactor: extract rollout policy evaluator and decision API; 2) feat: multi-metric quorum + grace window; 3) test/telemetry: e2e tests and add metrics/dashboards
diff_snippets: services/rollouts/policy/evaluator.go: Extracted EvaluatePolicy(ctx, rollout) returning (Decision, reason). Moved existing threshold checks into modular policies.
services/rollouts/policy/quorum_policy.go: New file implementing multi-metric quorum logic (require K of N metrics to breach). Includes unit tests for edge cases (missing metric windows).
services/rollouts/policy/grace_window.go: Added debounce timer that suppresses rollbacks until graceWindow elapsed since violation start.

services/rollouts/shadow/quarantine.go: Shadow probe can now mark variant state=quarantine; quarantine isolates variant from weighted traffic while continuing background probes. Added admin API to manually release variant.
review_comments: Maya Rosen: Nice refactor. Two concerns: 1) evaluator.go's EvaluatePolicy takes a large rollout object — can we pass a thin view to make unit tests simpler? 2) make graceWindow configurable per-rollout and default to 30s.

Author (Avery Chen): I extracted a RolloutView (thin) in second commit so tests can construct decisions without full cluster state. Grace window defaulted to 30s and supported per-rollout override. PTAL.
Luis Ortega: Can you add a metric for 'quorum_evaluations_total' and count per-decision labels (rollback/hold/continue)? We need this for alerting.

Author: Added rollout_metrics.go with 'quorum_evaluations_total' and 'rollout_decision_total' with labels. CI e2e still failing on timing flakiness in integration; added retries and test harness improvements.
Devon Park: Approve after CI passes — I want one more e2e run verifying shadow quarantine doesn't impact production latency.
